summary: New in Update 17.0. Infantry and defense civ with a Highland Cattle food economy, Fishponds for gold and a Mustering Hall that spawns armies on demand. The standard opening is Stone of Destiny around 4:55; Abbey of the Isles leads into Men-at-Arms aggression or a fast Castle.
openings: Stone of Destiny eco (Swaggy): Tower House on gold first, 6 Highland Cattle on berries, Feudal around 4:55, Kirkmen build Fishponds for gold.
Abbey of the Isles Men-at-Arms (Swaggy): Feudal around 4:50, 10 Men-at-Arms with the Saint's Relic in the barracks, forward Blacksmith to heal.
Abbey of the Isles into Tower of Skye fast Castle around 7:35, then a Mustering Hall raid (Swaggy's Border Reiver build).

spikes.label: Men-at-Arms with the Saint's Relic
spikes.detail: Abbey of the Isles' relic speeds production by 135% and heals; Swaggy's cheese hits with 10 Men-at-Arms right after Feudal.
spikes.answer: Wall and get archers or a tower up before 5:30; don't fight Men-at-Arms with spearmen.

spikes.label: Mustering Hall
spikes.detail: From Feudal the Mustering Hall turns food into instant reinforcements, so their army can appear out of nowhere.
spikes.answer: Count their food bank and military buildings, not just the units you see.

spikes.label: Gallowglass and Stealth Forests
spikes.detail: Gallowglass brace against cavalry and deal area damage; Tower of Skye makes Stealth Forests where their infantry hit harder.
spikes.answer: Ranged units and siege, kept away from the forest edges. Don't send cavalry into Gallowglass.

spikes.label: Gunpowder and Border Reivers
spikes.detail: Dhùn Èideann's cannons and gunpowder range, Tacksmen and Border Reivers that shred cavalry and archers.
spikes.answer: Heavy infantry and siege of your own; avoid ranged cavalry fights.

scout: Tower House on gold and cows on berries is the normal start
Stone of Destiny means eco; Abbey of the Isles means Men-at-Arms or a fast Castle
A barracks plus a forward blacksmith means the Men-at-Arms cheese
Mustering Hall and its Highland or Lowland techs

pairings.why: Ranged damage that's extra strong against light infantry, with spears against cavalry.
Tanky area-damage front line with archers behind.
Fast raiders on villagers while armored infantry hold the front.

winConditions.detail: Tower Houses and Keeps that can be repaired after falling make them hard to raid.
Mustered infantry floods in Castle Age.
Highland Cattle and Fishponds keep food and gold flowing with fewer villagers.

howToBeat: Kill the Highland Cattle on the berries: they're their early food.
Fight in the open, away from Stealth Forests and Tower Houses.
Against the Men-at-Arms cheese, archers and a quick wall; don't waste spearmen on them.
Siege and ranged units beat their slow infantry; cavalry struggles into Gallowglass.
